gaps.explanation: 'The + nationality adjective' = the people as a group: the French, the British.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.
gaps.explanation: 'Have a wonderful/great/good time' — 'time' here is countable and takes 'a'.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
They drove to ___ south of France for the summer.
gaps.explanation: 'By train' takes no article; 'the south of France' takes 'the' (compass areas).
'MA' is pronounced /em/, starting with a vowel sound, so 'an MA'.

gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.
'Have an eye for something' — fixed idiom with 'an'.

gaps.sentence: ___ information you sent was extremely helpful.
gaps.explanation: 'The information you sent' — the clause defines it; information is uncountable.
